claim_boundary: Bounded RTL-stage additive preauthority package work only. It may construct and independently verify a distinct V16 static successor with synthetic non-sensitive fixtures, but grants no execution authority and permits no official payload open, evaluator sweep, G8/G4/G2/G1 conclusion, checkpoint-176 work, RTL correctness conclusion, verification-stage work, synthesis/PPA, FPGA/U280 work, or stage transition.

failure_taxonomy.observed_boundary: The V15 evaluator call was entered and the sealed payload was opened once; no result was published, and the durable terminal retained only a failure-detail SHA-256.
failure_taxonomy.repair_routing: Do not repair or replay V15. Build a distinct successor only after a marker-free production-path fixture proves evaluator-return decode, schema, record, result-publication, and terminal-attribution behavior.

required_changes: Create a distinct additive V16 action root, action ID, package identity, schemas, launcher/transport identities, and separately named empty writable runtime namespace; never modify V15 in place.

Factor one pure evaluator-return processing routine used by the production launcher after evaluate_bundle_once returns and by the marker-free fixture. The shared routine must perform canonical JSON decode, result-schema validation, exact result-record validation, and preparation of durable result bytes.

Add a structured non-sensitive failure_stage field to the V16 first-terminal contract. At minimum distinguish EVALUATOR_CALL, CANONICAL_DECODE, RESULT_SCHEMA, RESULT_RECORD, RESULT_PUBLICATION, TERMINAL_BUILD, TERMINAL_SCHEMA, and TERMINAL_PUBLICATION; successful terminals use null.
Preserve a failure_detail_sha256 for forensic binding, but do not use that digest as the only durable localization evidence.

Build a deterministic synthetic fixture that does not import, read, deserialize, hash-open, or project the official sealed tensor and does not invoke the official evaluator. The fixture must inject schema-conforming evaluator-return bytes and targeted malformed variants through the same shared production routine.

Exercise both terminal outcomes structurally: one all-hard-gates-fail result with selected_candidate null and one first-passing result, plus mutations for noncanonical JSON, schema mismatch, exact-key/binding mismatch, create-once result collision, and terminal validation/publication failure. Verify each mutation maps to the declared failure_stage.

Have the independent verifier prove by source/AST inspection that production and fixture call the same evaluator-return processing routine in the same order, and that the fixture cannot reach authority, credential, ledger, official result, official terminal, sealed tensor, transport, launcher, controller, or evaluator start paths.
Bind all frozen benchmark identities, tool versions, official inputs, evaluator bytes, result schema, hard gates, candidate order, and selection policy before Fresh-L2 review.
required_outputs: a new immutable V16 static action root with no package-local live state
a separately named empty V16 runtime namespace
a canonical V16 package manifest and checksum
V16 authority, credential, ledger, first-terminal, and Fresh-L2 acceptance schemas
a shell-free transport and create-once launcher that retain exact argv/cwd/four-key environment binding
a marker-free evaluator-return-path fixture report with per-stage mutation results
an independent static verifier report with zero official target starts and zero official payload opens
a Fresh-L2 static acceptance explicitly granting no execution authority

objective: Close the V15 consumed orphan without replay, then construct and obtain Fresh-L2 static acceptance for a distinct marker-free V16 successor whose production evaluator-return/decode/schema/record path is exercised non-consumingly and whose future post-consumption failures are durably attributable by stage.
prohibited_actions: invoke, retry, replay, resume, repair, replace, or mutate the V15 action, authority, ledger, terminal, package, runtime namespace, or acceptance
open, deserialize, inspect, project, or execute against the official sealed tensor during this preauthority task
create V16 authority, credential, consumed ledger, official result, first terminal, attempt marker, or execution marker
invoke the V16 transport, launcher, controller, evaluator, or any G8/G4/G2/G1 numerical sweep
alter the evaluator, official inputs, candidate order, hard gates, score policy, result semantics, or benchmark interface
infer G8/G4/G2/G1 counters or an RTL correctness result from V15
modify RTL, verification references, constraints, certified PPA evidence, XRT, FPGA, HBM2, U280, research/PIPELINE_STATE.json, or current_stage
inspect hidden harnesses, golden outputs, or non-public evaluator outputs
terminal_action: Stop after Fresh-L2 static acceptance with all V16 live/consuming files absent. A later, separately authorized Engineer mission is required to execute V16 exactly once.
